changelog:
postking-social 1.0.1

- Expanded skill capabilities to cover manual post entry, social account connection/disconnection, asset library management, bulk post generation, and per-platform rules/templates.
- Added procedures and tool references for manual content saving (`create_post`), social account management, asset uploads, and bulk post generation (`generate_bulk_posts`).
- Updated minimal tool set with new methods for asset handling, account linking, and template workflows.
- Refined usage guidance to clarify when to use manual save, recurring cadence, or bulk fill flows.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
summary: Never run out of things to post. Generate, approve, and schedule across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, and Facebook, plus a recurring weekly cadence (Smart Week). Delivers a full, on-brand posting calendar without the daily grind.
